messages:
incbot: INCIDENT P1 — CedarBridge (dedicated VPC) auth failing in eu-west-1. Alerting: 401 spike on tenant cedarbridge-prod, errors from auth-proxy 35/min. Impact: all generation and embeddings calls returning 401/invalid_token. Pager: @maria oncall-sre paging. react :rotating_light:

maria (oncall-sre): seeing the 401 spike in the dashboard. traces show token validation rejects with 'kid mismatch' in auth-proxy logs. Posting recent log snippet: ```auth-proxy | 2026-03-15T10:02:43Z ERROR validate_token: no key for kid=ab12ef from issuer https://idp.cedarbridge.com/.well-known/jwks.json```

dave (eng-auth): thanks — checking JWKS fetches. Could be a rotation on customer IdP or our JWKS cache returned stale payload. Pulling jwks from the idp now.

chen (eng-runtime): CedarBridge uses a dedicated pool + private control plane, their tokens are validated in our VPC auth layer (auth-proxy) that caches JWKS for 5m. If their IdP rotated faster and reordered kids we could get a validation race.

lee (customer-success): CedarBridge reports users started seeing auth failures ~09:58 UTC, they did a key rotation a minute earlier. They say their IdP returned 503 intermittently during the rotation window.

maria (oncall-sre): reproduce test to verify current state: ```curl -v https://idp.cedarbridge.com/.well-known/jwks.json -H 'Accept: application/json'``` response: HTTP/1.1 200 OK but payload contains keys with kids: `["cd34gh","xy99zz"]` — our logs show token with kid `ab12ef` which is not present. That kid might be the previous key.

dave (eng-auth): that confirms rotation cleared the old kid from JWKS; our cached token validation will fail for in-flight tokens signed with old key. Need to decide mitigation: 1) accept old tokens by falling back to our JWKS cache backup, 2) request CedarBridge to reissue tokens with new kid, or 3) temporarily relax kid enforcement (risky).

raj (account-exec): CedarBridge is on an SLA for Dedicated. They are already escalating internally. They want an ETA and mitigation ASAP — revenue-impacting.

maria (oncall-sre): immediate mitigation plan: force-auth-proxy to use last-known-good JWKS backup (we persist last 3 fetches). I'm going to trigger a reload to point at backup file to accept `ab12ef` for 10 minutes while CedarBridge finishes rotation. If that doesn't stabilize, we'll proxy requests to their dedicated pool's fallback auth endpoint.

deploy-bot: deploy request queued: restart auth-proxy shard auth-eu-west-1-3 with env AUTH_JWKS_OVERRIDE=/var/secrets/jwks/cedarbridge-lastgood.json — will run in 30s.

chen (eng-runtime): note: restarting auth-proxy on a dedicated pool node will briefly drop in-flight requests. We'll stagger restarts across 3 replicas. Doing graceful drain.

maria (oncall-sre): running checks post-override: monitoring 401 rate. ``watch 'curl -s https://platform.api.redwood.internal/metrics/auth/cedarbridge | jq .401_rate'`` seeing drop from 35/min to 2/min after override. Good sign.

dave (eng-auth): I'm tailing auth-proxy logs: now we see validation succeed for tokens with kid `ab12ef`. Also adding a quick code guard to try cached JWKS if current JWKS misses a kid for tokens signed within last 15m. I'll open a hotfix PR but for now the override is the safe path.

lee (customer-success): CedarBridge confirms auth restored for most clients. They will hold all further key rotations for 20 minutes and coordinate with us. They also asked for postmortem and a permanent fix.

maria (oncall-sre): root cause: customer IdP performed key rotation while their JWKS endpoint returned partial results (503s), leading to a window where our fetch removed the old kid before all tokens expired. Race between IdP rotation + our cache TTL.

dave (eng-auth): immediate action items: 1) hotfix: accept last-known-good JWKS when validation fails for kid mismatch for tokens minted within configurable grace window (15m) — will ship behind a feature flag. 2) increase JWKS fetch backoff and add jitter to avoid cascading deletes on intermittent 5xx from customer IdPs. 3) document recommendation for customers: publish rotated keys with key rollover plan and maintain old key for token TTL + small buffer.

raj (account-exec): pushing to CedarBridge leadership for a joint postmortem. They want timeline and recommendations. I'll coordinate a 1:1 later today.

maria (oncall-sre): operational follow-ups: - create incident page, assign severity P1 - notify support for any lingering customer cases - schedule oncall blameless postmortem + timeline.

chen (eng-runtime): I ran the full integration test against dedicated pool routing after override. Perf unaffected. I'll wait for dave's PR to merge before reverting override.

deploy-bot: auth-proxy restart across replicas completed, staged with 5m stagger.

maria (oncall-sre): moving to monitoring mode. If 401 rate < 5/min for next 15m we'll mark as mitigated and move to post-incident. Leaving channel open for final handoff.

lee (customer-success): CedarBridge thanks the team. They're filing internal ticket to avoid mid-day rotation next week.

dave (eng-auth): PR opened: "jwks: fallback to last-known-good on kid miss (featureflag)" link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/auth-proxy/pull/842 (will merge after tests) — deploy plan: canary then global.

maria (oncall-sre): last checks at 10:14 UTC show steady state. Setting last_message_ts to 2165432845. Action items assigned: dave -> auth hotfix, chen -> adjust restart procedure doc, ops -> incident page + customer comms. Will follow up for postmortem. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
